verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs say it captures receipts at swipe time and fills in memos and categories automatically, codes them to the correct GL account, and runs AI that flags fraud and scans transactions for anomalies in real time. The CLI also exposes memo-suggestions, and bill-pay OCR is claimed at 99% line-item accuracy. missing for 10: explicit duplicate-expense detection, independent or hands-on corroboration of AI coding and fraud-flagging accuracy.
